_README: Instrument- and method-level values that can only be known after lab work. Each entry with placeholder=true is shown highlighted in the app until it is filled in. Search for TBD-LAB.

analytical_sd_permil.tbd_note: EA-IRMS analytical precision for δ15N (1 SD of replicate standards / check samples, ‰). Used to weight curve fits.

min_weaning_drop_permil.tbd_note: Minimum nursing-to-adult δ15N drop (‰) treated as a real weaning signal rather than noise. Calibrate against known-age reference animals.

transition_threshold.tbd_note: Fraction of the δ15N drop used to define weaning onset/completion for smooth curves (0.05 = 5 % / 95 %). Decide after validation against known-age animals.

reference_dataset.tbd_note: CSV of known-age modern reference animals (with known_weaning_age_months) used by the validation suite.

growth_layer_offset_mm.tbd_note: Extra tooth growth (mm) captured by each horizontal section because dentine growth layers are oblique (time averaging, after Tsutaya 2020 / MDSS). Measure from thin sections of cattle/pig/horse teeth; MDSS values are for human teeth only.

adult_baselines.tbd_note: Mean and SD of adult-female δ15N for each site and species (bone collagen), after WARN's maternal baseline. Used to report nursing enrichment and optionally to constrain the adult plateau.

inner_dentine_weight.tbd_note: Relative volume of the latest-formed (innermost) dentine in a horizontal section compared with the earliest (1 = equal). Estimate from thin-section geometry of livestock teeth (cf. MDSS volume weighting).
